title.zh: 【何一：币安年收入足以覆盖被盗损失】
title.en: 【何一：币安年收入足以覆盖被盗损失】

current_state.zh: Binance co-founder Yi He said Binance's annual revenue is enough to absorb losses from the theft incident and that it need not sell its SpaceX shares, which CZ said have grown from a $500M Twitter-era investment to over $1B in value.
current_state.en: Binance co-founder Yi He said Binance's annual revenue is enough to absorb losses from the theft incident and that it need not sell its SpaceX shares, which CZ said have grown from a $500M Twitter-era investment to over $1B in value.
